assets.name: 余烬·断层
assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: one high-end fantasy bow concept illustration for a Skyrim solid-light weapon collection. Portrait canvas, exactly one complete upright bow centered on an almost black plain background, full tips visible with generous margins, no character, no arrows, no lettering, no watermarks. Three-quarter view shallow enough to read the silhouette and depth. Draw the weapon as substantial solid geometry made of colored luminous energy: broad faces, clear bevels, restrained edge glow, colored midtones and dark recesses, NOT white overexposure, NOT metallic hardware or leather. A practical short central palm grip and clear arrow passage; one straight thin energy string connects upper and lower nocks to the right. Sparse small matching geometric particles close to the limbs suggest draw effects; no large aura or magic circle around the whole weapon, no hexagram. Credible connected 3D geometry, moderately thick forms, readable negative spaces. The design must depart strongly from generic S-shaped double-ribbon bows, zodiac horns, repeated chains of diamonds and scorpion stingers. Studio-quality game prop concept rendering, precise edges and compelling sculptural silhouette. Design: FAULTLINE. Crimson and rose-red energy bow. A compact, heavy rectangular C-bracket silhouette built from four large staggered broad rectangular slab limbs, with chamfered polygonal corners. The upper and lower arms bend through distinct 45-degree elbows, not a smooth curve. Two offset stepped plate layers with long rectangular slots and short thick connecting blocks, strong asymmetrical stair-step outer contour. The central grip is a sturdy beveled rectangular bar supported by a single offset angular knuckle guard. Outer bow sits left of string, nocks reach right at upper/lower ends. No axe points or pincers, no horns, no floating disconnected plates. Tiny rectangular ember fragments shedding from the slab seams. A bold architectural brutalist energy weapon with a visibly wide and weighty silhouette.
